assumption_provenance.method: Driver-based five-year forecast (Revenue -> EBIT -> NOPAT -> FCFF)

notes: Upper bound assumes the entire short-term investments balance is nonoperating and unrestricted; it is not a verified valuation.
Conservative bound subtracts the full restricted-investments balance; some restrictions may belong to excluded long-term investments, so this bound may understate eligible securities.

capex_sensitivity.label: Persistent-high-CapEx sensitivity (FY-latest capex intensity), not an established forecast.

assumptions.label: Mature incremental ROIC is an assumed parameter (not market-calibrated).
Mature incremental ROIC is an assumed parameter (not market-calibrated).

limitations: Driver-based FCFF forecast; drivers are derived from historical ratios/trends, not forward guidance.
Normalized operating tax rate is a documented baseline, separate from the WACC marginal tax rate.
Operating NWC ratio uses the latest fiscal-year-end balance sheet (a single point rather than a multi-year average).
The model assumes driver ratios are stable over five years; scenario spreads are rule-based.

Forecast cash flows are discounted using full-year periods from the valuation date (a rolling-forward simplification; a fractional fiscal-stub adjustment is not applied). The intrinsic value and the market price are therefore non-contemporaneous and are compared as approximations.
No automatic buy/sell instruction or live trading is provided.
